contexts.text: Some things (of Providence) from good pleasure. AC 2447:2. AC 9940, Explained.
Odour = what is pleasing, that is, grateful. References.
The year of good pleasure of Jehovah = the time of the New Church.
What is pleasing as to regeneration. Signified.
Of the good pleasure of the Lord knowing...
In their good pleasure they unstrung an ox () = that from a depraved will they...
Good pleasure = the will; here, a depraved will.
To give salvation to everyone of good pleasure, provided they have faith, is impossible.
A land of good pleasure () = the Church grateful to the Lord.

To their being pleasing before Jehovah () = the Lord's Divine in them... For what pleases the Lord is the Divine, which is from Himself with a man. Spirit, or Angel; for it is then in another, in whom it is regarded, and thus it pleases.
By this is not signified what is pleasing, but permission...
When it is pleasing to the Lord...
(The idea) that all men could be saved of good pleasure.
(The idea) that salvation is nothing, but the Divine good pleasure.
(He said) God... bestows faith of... good pleasure...
They who are led by the Lord... do nothing except of the Lord's good pleasure...
The Lord's permission, leave, good pleasure, and will (distinguished).
The Lord's will is called His good pleasurein the Old Testament; thus it = the Divine love. Illustrated AE 391:16.
The term good pleasure in the Hebrew also means will.
His Advent is meant by the year of the good pleasure of Jehovah ().
